instructions.value: Participants viewed neutral or negative pictures for 2 seconds, then either attended to the picture or reappraised it for 4 seconds. In reappraisal trials they were instructed to reinterpret the picture to decrease its negative emotional intensity; in attend-negative trials they continued attending without changing the experienced emotion. They then rated negativity on a four-point scale, relaxed when cued, and proceeded to the next trial.
